I'm ready to help you explore the codebase and design implementation plans! 

Let me start by getting familiar with the current project structure and understanding what we're working with.

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">find /home/squinlan/artifact-engine -type f -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.md" | head -30</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<parameter name="command">ls -la /home/squinlan/artifact-engine/</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cat /home/squinlan/artifact-engine/package.json</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">find /home/squinlan/artifact-engine -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" \) | head -20</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cat /home/squinlan/artifact-engine/README.md 2>/dev/null || echo "No README found"</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

I'm warmed up and ready! I can see this is an Artifact Engine project. I'm in **READ-ONLY planning mode** - I can explore the codebase, understand its structure, and design implementation plans, but I cannot and will not modify any files.

What requirements would you like me to explore and design a plan for?
